label: Fixed development comparison of unassociated retrieval against opt-in declared-association retrieval

runs.baseline: six frozen cases without --associations, fresh store per case
runs.proposed: the same six cases with the fixed declaration file, fresh stores
runs.associated_followup: the fixed follow-up query with the declaration file

expected_before_run: association fires only for the followup case; partial and budget cases unchanged because no primary passage is selected; primary selection identical everywhere
honesty: Caller semantic support remains a caller judgment. The engine adds no semantic-support, completeness or held-out claim. The 180-byte miss is retained as a budget omission.

raw.comparison.json: per-case baseline vs proposed outcome, bytes, packet identity, released items
raw.associated-packet.json: the proposed followup-case packet with association provenance
raw.declarations.json: the fixed declaration file used for all proposed runs
raw.followup-query-associated.json: the fixed follow-up query under the proposed configuration
